# Generated by pyke from whiteboard.pyke - do not edit, changes will be overwritten.

add_library(wb_core STATIC)
target_link_libraries(wb_core PUBLIC GLM)

file(GLOB_RECURSE wb_core_SOURCES_0 CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "src/*.cpp"
)
target_sources(wb_core PRIVATE ${wb_core_SOURCES_0})
file(GLOB_RECURSE wb_core_MODULES_1 CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "src/*.cppm"
)
target_sources(wb_core PUBLIC
    FILE_SET CXX_MODULES BASE_DIRS "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}" FILES
        ${wb_core_MODULES_1}
)
target_compile_options(wb_core PRIVATE "$<$<BOOL:$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>>:/W4>")
target_compile_options(wb_core PRIVATE "$<$<BOOL:$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang,AppleClang>>:-Wall;-Wextra;-Wpedantic>")
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(wb_core PRIVATE
        "/utf-8"
        "/permissive-"
        "/Zc:preprocessor"
        "/Zc:__cplusplus"
        "/MP"
    )
endif()
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    target_compile_options(wb_core PRIVATE
        "-Wno-missing-designated-field-initializers"
    )
endif()

get_target_property(wb_core_ALL_SOURCES wb_core SOURCES)
if(wb_core_ALL_SOURCES)
    foreach(_src IN LISTS wb_core_ALL_SOURCES)
        cmake_path(ABSOLUTE_PATH _src BASE_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} NORMALIZE OUTPUT_VARIABLE _abs)
        cmake_path(IS_PREFIX CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR "${_abs}" NORMALIZE _inside)
        if(_inside)
            source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES "${_abs}")
        else()
            source_group("External Sources" FILES "${_abs}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()
